verdict.rationale: The app documents a personal-account device-code sign-in through omnirush.ai/console that makes it ready to use with your account's model catalog. Bring-your-own provider keys are described as an optional addition, so key management is not required. The 'free' claim comes only from marketing copy, and nothing describes the free tier itself. Missing for 10: documented free-tier terms and usage limits, explicit confirmation that sign-in alone grants free access, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with a personal account to get free-tier access without managing API keys

citations.quote: Your browser opens omnirush.ai/console with a device code; approve it and the app is ready.
GPT 6.1 Sol and the other models in your account's catalog are available from the model picker.
Omnirush: State-of-the-art models, free, for every profession
You can also add your own OpenAI, Anthropic or other provider keys.
